$comment: Lanternlight Claude Code settings. Windows paths MUST use forward slashes - a single backslash makes this file invalid JSON, and an unparseable settings file registers no hooks and warns about nothing. The PreToolUse matcher MUST name every shell tool that can reach git: this machine is PowerShell-primary, and a matcher of 'Bash' alone let a commit issued through the PowerShell tool bypass the gate entirely. Measured 2026-08-09. Attribution is BLANKED, not merely unset: CLAUDE.md forbids a Co-Authored-By trailer as operator policy, and the harness injects one by default. Both the current key (attribution.commit) and the deprecated one (includeCoAuthoredBy) are set, because an older client reads only the latter and would reintroduce the trailer silently. Set 2026-09-06.
